entities.name: CysN/CysC bifunctional enzyme
observations: Supplied 646-aa sequence is a strong full-length homolog of reviewed CysN/CysC proteins (51.6–54.8% identity; 96.3–99.4% query coverage); activity assignment is homology-supported, not direct assay evidence.
Reviewed homolog annotations assign ATP sulfurylase and APS kinase activities in sulfur assimilation.

entities.name: Sulfate to APS
observations: Sulfate + ATP + H+ → adenosine 5′-phosphosulfate (APS) + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:18133. Reference CysN activity in an ATP sulfurylase complex can couple APS synthesis to GTP hydrolysis.

entities.name: APS to PAPS
observations: APS + ATP → 3′-phosphoadenylyl sulfate (PAPS) + ADP + H+; Rhea RHEA:24152. APS kinase activity.
